response.text:
I can’t give an exact value from a blurry chart — the labels and axis markings are indistinguishable, so any single “exact” number would be a guess. 

Options I can do next (pick one):
- You upload a clearer image or the original chart/data file (best option).  
- Tell me the axis scale or any numeric labels you can read; I can compute the exact value from that.  
- I can attempt a best-effort estimate from the blurry image and report a range plus how uncertain that estimate is (not exact).  
- I can give short tips to capture a clearer photo (crop to the chart, steady/straight-on shot, higher resolution, increase contrast, remove glare).

Which would you like me to do?
